description: Ingredient safety watchlist for children. Sources: FDA 21 CFR, AAP 2018 Policy, CSPI Chemical Cuisine, WHO.

ingredients.name: Red 3
ingredients.flag_reason: FDA banned in food (Jan 2025) after animal studies showed thyroid tumors. Linked to hyperactivity in children.
ingredients.source_citation: FDA 21 CFR Part 74; IARC Group 1 (animal carcinogen)

ingredients.name: Red 40
ingredients.flag_reason: AAP 2018: associated with hyperactivity and attention issues in children. Part of the 'Southampton Six' artificial food colors.

ingredients.name: Yellow 5
ingredients.flag_reason: Southampton Six artificial dye. Linked to hyperactivity in children. EU requires warning label.

ingredients.name: Yellow 6
ingredients.flag_reason: Southampton Six artificial dye. Hyperactivity concerns. EU warning label required.

ingredients.name: Blue 1
ingredients.flag_reason: Artificial dye with potential hyperactivity link. CSPI: Caution for children.

ingredients.name: Blue 2
ingredients.flag_reason: Artificial dye. Limited safety data for children. CSPI: Caution.

ingredients.name: Sodium Nitrate
ingredients.flag_reason: AAP 2018: nitrates in cured meats convert to nitrosamines (potential carcinogens). Especially concerning under age 3.

ingredients.name: Sodium Nitrite
ingredients.flag_reason: Converts to nitrosamines in stomach. AAP recommends limiting cured/processed meats in children's diet.

ingredients.name: BHA
ingredients.flag_reason: Reasonably anticipated human carcinogen (NTP). CSPI: Avoid. AAP 2018 listed as antioxidant preservative of concern.
ingredients.source_citation: NTP 15th Report on Carcinogens; CSPI Chemical Cuisine

ingredients.name: BHT
ingredients.flag_reason: Possible carcinogen in animal studies. CSPI: Caution. Some countries restrict in baby/children's food.

ingredients.name: TBHQ
ingredients.flag_reason: Linked to immune system issues in animal studies. Very high doses caused tumors. CSPI: Avoid.

ingredients.name: Carrageenan
ingredients.flag_reason: Linked to gut inflammation in animal studies. AAP 2018 listed as a concern. Particularly flagged for infant formula.
ingredients.source_citation: AAP Pediatrics 2018; Joanne Tobacman MD research

ingredients.name: Titanium Dioxide
ingredients.flag_reason: IARC Group 2B (possible carcinogen). EU banned in food (2022). Gut microbiome disruption in animal studies.

ingredients.name: Potassium Bromate
ingredients.flag_reason: Probable human carcinogen (IARC Group 2B). Banned in EU, Canada, UK, India. Still legal in US. FDA urged voluntary ban.
ingredients.source_citation: IARC Group 2B; FDA advisory 1999; India FSS Act

ingredients.name: Brominated Vegetable Oil
ingredients.flag_reason: FDA revoked GRAS status (2023). Bromine accumulates in fat and thyroid. Several countries have banned it.

ingredients.name: High Fructose Corn Syrup
ingredients.flag_reason: AAP: avoid added sugars entirely under age 2. HFCS contributes to obesity, insulin resistance, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease in children.
ingredients.source_citation: AAP 2016 Sugar Policy; WHO Free Sugars Guideline 2015

ingredients.name: Saccharin
ingredients.flag_reason: AAP 2019: non-nutritive sweeteners not recommended for children. Alters gut microbiome. Historical bladder cancer concerns.

ingredients.name: Acesulfame Potassium
ingredients.flag_reason: AAP 2019: non-nutritive sweeteners not recommended for children. Limited long-term safety data.

ingredients.name: Aspartame
ingredients.flag_reason: AAP 2019: non-nutritive sweeteners not recommended for children. IARC classified as possibly carcinogenic (Group 2B, 2023).

ingredients.name: Sodium Benzoate
ingredients.flag_reason: Combines with Vitamin C to form benzene (carcinogen). AAP 2018: hyperactivity link in children especially with artificial dyes.

ingredients.name: Monosodium Glutamate
ingredients.flag_reason: FDA GRAS but adds to sodium load. Some sensitivity reported. Not recommended for infants under 12 months.

ingredients.name: Propyl Gallate
ingredients.flag_reason: Possible estrogenic activity. CSPI: Caution. Animal studies show tumor promotion at high doses.

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.flag_reason: ABSOLUTE risk: Clostridium botulinum spores in honey cause infant botulism. Strictly avoid under 12 months. No exceptions.
ingredients.source_citation: CDC Infant Botulism; AAP Bright Futures; FDA

ingredients.name: Partially Hydrogenated Oils
ingredients.flag_reason: FDA banned trans fats (2018). Partially hydrogenated oils are the primary source. No safe level for children.

ingredients.name: Artificial Sweeteners
ingredients.flag_reason: AAP 2019: non-nutritive sweeteners should be avoided in children. Sucralose alters gut microbiome in animal studies.
